license_required.quote: any person who practices or attempts to practice, or who advertises or holds himself or herself out as practicing, any system or mode of treating the sick or afflicted in this state, or who diagnoses, treats, operates for, or prescribes for any ailment, blemish, deformity, disease, disfigurement, disorder, injury, or other physical or mental condition of any person, without having at the time of so doing a valid, unrevoked, or unsuspended certificate as provided in this chapter ... is guilty of a public offense

issuing_authority.quote: There is in the Department of Consumer Affairs a Medical Board of California

name.quote: There is in the Department of Consumer Affairs a Medical Board of California

type.quote: There is in the Department of Consumer Affairs a Medical Board of California that consists of 15 members

umbrella_agency.quote: There is in the Department of Consumer Affairs a Medical Board of California

degree_required.value: Medical degree from an approved medical school
degree_required.quote: A diploma issued by an approved medical school. The requirements of the school shall have been at the time of granting the diploma in no degree less than those required under this chapter

accrediting_body.value: Liaison Committee on Medical Education; Committee on Accreditation of Canadian Medical Schools; Commission on Osteopathic College Accreditation; or ECFMG-evaluated foreign medical schools
accrediting_body.quote: Medical schools accredited by a national accrediting agency approved by the board and recognized by the United States Department of Education shall be deemed approved by the board.

required.quote: before a physician's and surgeon's license may be issued, each applicant ... shall show by evidence satisfactory to the board that the applicant has received credit for at least 12 months of board-approved postgraduate training for graduates of medical schools in the United States and Canada or 24 months of board-approved postgraduate training for graduates of foreign medical schools

duration.value: 12 months (US/Canada graduates) or 24 months (foreign medical graduates)
duration.quote: at least 12 months of board-approved postgraduate training for graduates of medical schools in the United States and Canada or 24 months of board-approved postgraduate training for graduates of foreign medical schools

kind.quote: postgraduate training program approved by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education (ACGME) in the United States, the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada (RCPSC) in Canada, or the College of Family Physicians of Canada (CFPC) in Canada

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) Step 3
exams.notes: Maximum 4 attempts for Step 3; reciprocity applicants may qualify with equivalent out-of-state exam
exams.quote: An applicant shall have obtained a passing score on all parts of Step 3 of the United States Medical Licensing Examination within not more than four attempts in order to be eligible for a physician's and surgeon's certificate.

exams.name: National examination for medical licensure in biomedical sciences and clinical sciences
exams.notes: Including geriatric medicine; determined by Division of Licensing to be essential for unsupervised practice
exams.quote: An applicant for a physician's and surgeon's certificate shall pass the national examination for medical licensure in biomedical sciences and clinical sciences, including geriatric medicine, determined by the Division of Licensing to be essential for the unsupervised practice of medicine.

interval_years.quote: All physician and surgeon's certificates ... shall expire at 12 midnight on the last day of the month in which the license was issued during the second year of a two-year term commencing from the date of issuance

renewal_fee_usd.quote: For licenses that expire on or after January 1, 2024, the biennial renewal fee shall be one thousand one hundred fifty-one dollars ($1,151).

required.quote: the board shall adopt and administer standards for the continuing education of those licensees. The board shall require each licensed physician and surgeon to demonstrate satisfaction of the continuing education requirements at intervals of not less than four nor more than six years.

value: pain management and treatment of terminally ill and dying patients (12 credit hours, one-time)
risks of addiction associated with use of Schedule II drugs (for licensees on/after Jan 1, 2019)
geriatric medicine (20% of mandatory CE hours for internists/family physicians with >25% elderly patient population)
topical_requirements.quote: All physicians and surgeons shall complete a mandatory continuing education course in the subjects of pain management and the treatment of terminally ill and dying patients.

available.quote: The board shall issue a physician's and surgeon's certificate to an applicant who meets all of the following requirements: (a) The applicant holds an unlimited license as a physician and surgeon in another state or states, or in a Canadian province or Canadian provinces

requirements.value: Applicant must hold unlimited license in another state/province for at least 4 years; no disciplinary action; passed equivalent exam; completed at least 1 year postgraduate training and board-specialty certification or 2 years postgraduate training or 1 year plus clinical competency exam.
requirements.quote: The applicant has held an unrestricted license to practice medicine, in a state or states, in a Canadian province or Canadian provinces, or as a member of the active military, United States Public Health Services, or other federal program, for a period of at least four years.

exists.quote: There is in the Department of Consumer Affairs a Medical Board of California that consists of 15 members, 7 of whom shall be public members.

national_certification.quote: the Division of Licensing may issue a physician and surgeon's certificate to a diplomate of the National Board of Medical Examiners

national_association.value: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); California Medical Association (CMA); Accreditation Council for Continuing Medical Education (ACCME)
national_association.quote: Educational activities that meet the content standards set forth in this section and are accredited by the California Medical Association or the Accreditation Council for Continuing Medical Education may be deemed by the Division of Licensing to meet its continuing medical education standards.

regulatory_model.quote: any person who practices or attempts to practice, or who advertises or holds himself or herself out as practicing, any system or mode of treating the sick or afflicted in this state ... without having at the time of so doing a valid, unrevoked, or unsuspended certificate as provided in this chapter ... is guilty of a public offense

credential_type.quote: The Division of Licensing shall issue one form of certificate to all physicians and surgeons licensed by the board which shall be designated as a "physician's and surgeon's certificate."

is_mandatory.quote: any person who practices or attempts to practice, or who advertises or holds himself or herself out as practicing, any system or mode of treating the sick or afflicted in this state ... without having at the time of so doing a valid, unrevoked, or unsuspended certificate as provided in this chapter ... is guilty of a public offense

title_protection.quote: Any person who uses in any sign, business card, or letterhead, or, in an advertisement, the words "doctor" or "physician," the letters or prefix "Dr.," the initials "M.D." or "D.O.," ... without having at the time of so doing a valid, unrevoked, and unsuspended certificate as a physician and surgeon under this chapter, is guilty of a misdemeanor.

scope_protection.quote: any person who practices or attempts to practice, or who advertises or holds himself or herself out as practicing, any system or mode of treating the sick or afflicted in this state, or who diagnoses, treats, operates for, or prescribes for any ailment ... without having at the time of so doing a valid, unrevoked, or unsuspended certificate as provided in this chapter ... is guilty of a public offense

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or conspiring to violate any provision of the Medical Practice Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly, assisting in or abetting the violation of, or conspiring to violate any provision of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence in the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Two or more negligent acts or omissions in practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Repeated negligent acts. To be repeated, there must be two or more negligent acts or omissions.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence in the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of any act involving dishonesty or corruption substantially related to qualifications or duties of a physician
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The commission of any act involving dishonesty or corruption that is substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of a physician and surgeon.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any action or conduct that would have warranted denial of the certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any action or conduct that would have warranted the denial of a certificate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to attend and participate in a board interview without good cause when subject to investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure by a certificate holder, in the absence of good cause, to attend and participate in an interview by the board no later than 30 calendar days after being notified by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Action intended to cause patient to rescind consent to release records to the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any action of the licensee, or another person acting on behalf of the licensee, intended to cause their patient or their patient's authorized representative to rescind consent to release the patient's medical records to the board or the Department of Consumer Affairs, Health Quality Investigation Unit.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dissuading, intimidating, or tampering with a patient, witness, or any person to prevent reporting or testimony about a licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dissuading, intimidating, or tampering with a patient, witness, or any person in an attempt to prevent them from reporting or testifying about a licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any offense substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of a physician and surgeon
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The conviction of any offense substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of a physician and surgeon constitutes unprofessional conduct within the meaning of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of violating federal or state laws regulating dangerous drugs or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The conviction of a charge of violating any federal statutes or regulations or any statute or regulation of this state, regulating dangerous drugs or controlled substances, constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of controlled substances or alcohol to an extent that impairs ability to practice medicine safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use or prescribing for or administering to himself or herself, of any controlled substance; or the use of any of the dangerous drugs specified in Section 4022, or of alcoholic beverages, to the extent, or in such a manner as to be dangerous or injurious to the licensee, or to any other person or to the public, or to the extent that such use impairs the ability of the licensee to practice medicine safely

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing, or furnishing dangerous drugs without appropriate prior examination and medical indication
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing, or furnishing dangerous drugs as defined in Section 4022 without an appropriate prior examination and a medical indication, constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making or signing any false certificate or document related to practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly making or signing any certificate or other document directly or indirectly related to the practice of medicine or podiatry which falsely represents the existence or nonexistence of a state of facts, constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Altering or modifying medical records with fraudulent intent, or creating false medical records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Altering or modifying the medical record of any person, with fraudulent intent, or creating any false medical record, with fraudulent intent, constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful, unauthorized violation of professional confidence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The willful, unauthorized violation of professional confidence constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing, aiding, or abetting any unlicensed person to engage in the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The employing, directly or indirectly, the aiding, or the abetting of any unlicensed person or any suspended, revoked, or unlicensed practitioner to engage in the practice of medicine or any other mode of treating the sick or afflicted which requires a license to practice constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain adequate and accurate patient records for at least seven years
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure of a physician and surgeon to maintain adequate and accurate records relating to the provision of services to their patients for at least seven years after the last date of service to a patient constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising in violation of Section 17500 (false or misleading advertising)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any advertising in violation of Section 17500, relating to false or misleading advertising, constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine while under the influence of narcotic drugs or alcohol to an extent that impairs ability to practice safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No licensee shall practice medicine while under the influence of any narcotic drug or alcohol to such an extent as to impair his or her ability to conduct the practice of medicine with safety to the public and his or her patients. Violation of this section constitutes unprofessional conduct and is a misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, or other discipline of a medical license imposed by another state or federal agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The revocation, suspension, or other discipline, restriction, or limitation imposed by another state upon a license or certificate to practice medicine issued by that state, or the revocation, suspension, or restriction of the authority to practice medicine by any agency of the federal government, that would have been grounds for discipline in California of a licensee under this chapter, shall constitute grounds for disciplinary action for unprofessional conduct against the licensee in this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a certificate by fraud or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the Senior Assistant Attorney General of the Health Quality Enforcement Section shall initiate action against any licensee who obtains a certificate by fraud or misrepresentation

insurance_required.quote: It is unprofessional conduct for a physician and surgeon to fail to provide adequate security by liability insurance, or by participation in an interindemnity trust, for claims by patients arising out of surgical procedures performed outside of a general acute care hospital

establishment_regulation_required.quote: no physician and surgeon shall perform procedures in an outpatient setting using anesthesia, except local anesthesia or peripheral nerve blocks ... unless the setting is specified in Section 1248.1.

definition_quote.value: The physician's and surgeon's certificate authorizes the holder to use drugs or devices in or upon human beings and to sever or penetrate the tissues of human beings and to use any and all other methods in the treatment of diseases, injuries, deformities, and other physical and mental conditions.
definition_quote.quote: The physician's and surgeon's certificate authorizes the holder to use drugs or devices in or upon human beings and to sever or penetrate the tissues of human beings and to use any and all other methods in the treatment of diseases, injuries, deformities, and other physical and mental conditions.

value: any and all other methods in the treatment of diseases, injuries, deformities, and other physical and mental conditions
methods_authorized.quote: authorizes the holder to use drugs or devices in or upon human beings and to sever or penetrate the tissues of human beings and to use any and all other methods in the treatment of diseases, injuries, deformities, and other physical and mental conditions.

drug_authority.value: Full authority to prescribe, dispense, and administer dangerous drugs, controlled substances, and other prescription medications, including for pain management and intractable pain
drug_authority.quote: A physician and surgeon may prescribe for, or dispense or administer to, a person under their treatment for a medical condition dangerous drugs or prescription controlled substances for the treatment of pain or a condition causing pain, including, but not limited to, intractable pain.

license_status_types.quote: The board shall enforce and administer this article as to physician and surgeon certificate holders, including those who hold certificates that do not permit them to practice medicine, such as, but not limited to, retired, inactive, or disabled status certificate holders

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must obtain ECFMG certification, complete 24 months of board-approved ACGME postgraduate training (vs 12 months for US/Canada graduates), and graduate from a recognized foreign medical school.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: if the applicant attended a foreign medical school approved by the board pursuant to Section 2084, an official Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) Certification Status Report submitted by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates confirming the graduate is ECFMG certified.

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: each applicant ... shall show by evidence satisfactory to the board that the applicant has received credit for at least 12 months of board-approved postgraduate training for graduates of medical schools in the United States and Canada

pain_management_education_required.quote: All physicians and surgeons shall complete a mandatory continuing education course in the subjects of pain management and the treatment of terminally ill and dying patients. For the purposes of this section, this course shall be a one-time requirement of 12 credit hours

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: Prescribe medications without a cosigner, including prescriptions for controlled substances, if the licensee has the appropriate Drug Enforcement Agency registration or permit and is registered with the Department of Justice CURES program.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: An appropriate prior examination for prescribing does not require a synchronous interaction and can be achieved through telehealth including self-screening tools or questionnaires, provided the licensee complies with the appropriate standard of care.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: An appropriate prior examination does not require a synchronous interaction between the patient and the licensee and can be achieved through the use of telehealth, including, but not limited to, a self-screening tool or a questionnaire, provided that the licensee complies with the appropriate standard of care.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: an eligible out-of-state physician and surgeon may practice medicine in the state if the practice is limited to delivering health care via telehealth to an eligible patient.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Investigating the circumstances of practice of any physician and surgeon where there have been any judgments, settlements, or arbitration awards requiring the physician and surgeon or his or her professional liability insurer to pay an amount in damages in excess of a cumulative total of thirty thousand dollars ($30,000) with respect to any claim that injury or damage was proximately caused by the physician's and surgeon's error, negligence, or omission.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: The board shall investigate the circumstances underlying a report received pursuant to Section 805 or 805.01 within 30 days to determine if an interim suspension order or temporary restraining order should be issued.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The board may establish a Physician and Surgeon Health and Wellness Program for the early identification of, and appropriate interventions to support a physician and surgeon in his or her rehabilitation from, substance abuse to ensure that the physician and surgeon remains able to practice medicine in a manner that will not endanger the public health and safety

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: A licensee may be ordered to undergo a professional competency examination if, after investigation and review by a medical expert designated by the division or the Board of Podiatric Medicine, as applicable, there is reasonable cause to believe that the licensee is unable to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients.

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: a "locum tenens agency" shall not be deemed to be an employer, employment agency, employment counseling service, job listing service, nurse's registry, temporary services employer, or leasing employer of a licensee.
